_meta.description: Per-respondent scores on the one engagement factor behind the six-item battery.pulse questionnaire via ATTR_FACTOR_SCORE, each from an inline fit with MAT_FACTOR's knobs (the same loadings, order and sign as MAT_FACTOR on the same rows: about 0.58 to 0.75 on the five positively keyed items, about -0.65 on the reverse-keyed bat_dread, every uniqueness between 0.43 and 0.67, no warning). f1_regression is the regression (Thurstone) score of the default minres fit; f1_bartlett the Bartlett score of a maximum-likelihood fit (params.extraction "ml"). Both average 0 over the cohort; the regression score's standard deviation is below 1 (about 0.91: it shrinks toward the mean, the better predictor of the factor) and the Bartlett score's above it (about 1.09: unbiased for each respondent's level). A reverse-keyed item needs no recoding: its loading takes the sign. On a battery with several traits set params.factors and a rotation (two factors need at least five members).
_meta.name: attr_factor_score
